feed.label: FILM FACT

slides.headline: The mechanical shark in *Jaws* (1975) kept breaking down. So the film shows it less, and got scarier.
slides.sub: Sometimes the limit is the trick.

feed.caption:
The shark did not work. So you barely see it for the first hour, and your imagination does the rest.

Sometimes the thing that goes wrong is the thing that makes it great.

reels.label: FILM FACT

scenes.headline: The cat was *not* in the script.
The cat Marlon Brando holds in the opening of *The Godfather* (1972) was a stray the director found on the studio lot and handed to him.
Its purring was so loud some lines had to be re-recorded.
scenes.sub: Best unplanned casting ever.

reels.caption:
The most famous cat in cinema was a stray that wandered onto the lot. Sometimes the best idea is the one nobody planned.
